title: When using systemd boot, make `plasmashell --replace` warn people that it's for development usage only
line: Running "plasmashell --replace" in a systemd-managed session now prints a warning that it is meant for development and suggests "systemctl restart --user plasma-plasmashell.service".
explanation: With systemd startup, "plasmashell --replace" restarts the shell through KDBusService outside the plasma-plasmashell unit, so the new shell runs with a different environment and outside systemd's control, which has caused several confusing bug reports. Nothing told users that the habit is only meant for development. Open MR !7332 (applied here unchanged, three commits) moves plasma-shutdown's existing check for an active plasma-workspace.target into libkworkspace as KWorkSpace::isUsingSystemdBoot(), and plasmashell uses it to print a warning when --replace is used on a systemd-managed session, pointing to "systemctl restart --user plasma-plasmashell.service". The option itself keeps working.

commits.message:
shell: warn when --replace is used on a systemd-managed session

With systemd startup, plasmashell --replace restarts the shell outside
its unit, which gives it a different environment and causes subtle bugs.
Print a warning pointing to systemctl restart --user instead.

BUG: 474995

patches.diff:
From 8c362595bcd79da831f24942e862560b3f28fe3c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Fushan Wen <qydwhotmail@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 03:17:13 +0800
Subject: [PATCH 1/3] libkworkspace: add KWorkSpace::isUsingSystemdBoot()

Returns whether plasma-workspace.target is currently active, i.e.
whether the session is managed by systemd. This is the check that
plasma-shutdown already uses, moved here so that other components can
share it instead of duplicating the D-Bus calls, or instead of guessing
from the configuration that would be used on the next login.

A unit can be loaded but inactive, so the ActiveState property is
queried after GetUnit.
---
 libkworkspace/CMakeLists.txt |  1 +
 libkworkspace/kworkspace.cpp | 39 ++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++++
 libkworkspace/kworkspace.h   |  9 +++++++++
 3 files changed, 49 insertions(+)

diff --git a/libkworkspace/CMakeLists.txt b/libkworkspace/CMakeLists.txt
index 6f85f0af7d..c9885abbe4 100644
--- a/libkworkspace/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/libkworkspace/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 
 
 set(kworkspace_LIB_SRCS kdisplaymanager.cpp
+    kworkspace.cpp
     sessionmanagement.cpp
     sessionmanagementbackend.cpp
     autostartscriptdesktopfile.cpp
diff --git a/libkworkspace/kworkspace.cpp b/libkworkspace/kworkspace.cpp
index e69de29bb2..4e21a3bc5b 100644
--- a/libkworkspace/kworkspace.cpp
+++ b/libkworkspace/kworkspace.cpp
@@ -0,0 +1,39 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2024 David Edmundson <davidedmundson@kde.org>
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Fushan Wen <qydwhotmail@gmail.com>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+#include "kworkspace.h"
+
+#include <QDBusConnection>
+#include <QDBusMessage>
+#include <QDBusObjectPath>
+#include <QDBusReply>
+#include <QVariant>
+
+bool KWorkSpace::isUsingSystemdBoot()
+{
+    auto msg = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1"),
+                                              QStringLiteral("/org/freedesktop/systemd1"),
+                                              QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1.Manager"),
+                                              QStringLiteral("GetUnit"));
+    msg << QStringLiteral("plasma-workspace.target");
+
+    // "GetUnit" also succeeds for units that exist but are not running, so
+    // the state of the unit has to be checked as well.
+    const QDBusReply<QDBusObjectPath> reply = QDBusConnection::sessionBus().call(msg);
+    if (!reply.isValid()) {
+        return false;
+    }
+
+    msg = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1"),
+                                         reply.value().path(),
+                                         QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties"),
+                                         QStringLiteral("Get"));
+    msg << QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1.Unit") << QStringLiteral("ActiveState");
+
+    const QDBusReply<QVariant> stateReply = QDBusConnection::sessionBus().call(msg);
+    return stateReply.isValid() && stateReply.value().toString() == QLatin1String("active");
+}
diff --git a/libkworkspace/kworkspace.h b/libkworkspace/kworkspace.h
index df9a4dce10..73f5d51d30 100644
--- a/libkworkspace/kworkspace.h
+++ b/libkworkspace/kworkspace.h
@@ -88,6 +88,15 @@ enum ShutdownMode {
  */
 KWORKSPACE_EXPORT bool isShuttingDown();
 
+/**
+ * Used to check whether the Plasma session is currently managed by systemd,
+ * i.e. whether plasma-workspace.target is active.
+ *
+ * This queries the runtime state instead of the configuration that would be
+ * used on the next login, so it stays correct when the session setup changes.
+ */
+KWORKSPACE_EXPORT bool isUsingSystemdBoot();
+
 /**
  * Propagates the network address of the session manager in the
  * SESSION_MANAGER environment variable so that child processes can
--

From f67ed2c1eaa855461ccecc99f4cf897b05270a77 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Fushan Wen <qydwhotmail@gmail.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Oct 2026 03:17:13 +0800
Subject: [PATCH 2/3] shell: warn when --replace is used on a systemd-managed
 session

When the session is managed by systemd, "plasmashell --replace" restarts
the shell through KDBusService instead of restarting the systemd unit.
This takes a different code path than a regular start and can result in
subtle differences in behaviour, but it is a long-standing habit that is
still recommended all over the internet.

Print a warning pointing to "systemctl restart --user
plasma-plasmashell.service" instead. The option keeps working, it is
still needed to run plasmashell under a debugger.

BUG: 474995
FIXED-IN: 6.9
---
 shell/main.cpp | 9 +++++++++
 1 file changed, 9 insertions(+)

diff --git a/shell/main.cpp b/shell/main.cpp
index ce385db4e4..d45cd5a35f 100644
--- a/shell/main.cpp
+++ b/shell/main.cpp
@@ -34,6 +34,8 @@
 #include <KLocalizedString>
 #include <KSignalHandler>
 
+#include <kworkspace.h>
+
 #include <csignal>
 
 #if __has_include(<malloc.h>)
@@ -220,6 +222,13 @@ int main(int argc, char *argv[])
         replace = cliOptions.isSet(replaceOption);
     }
 
+    // Restarting plasmashell with --replace bypasses systemd, which results in a
+    // different environment than a regular start and can cause subtle bugs.
+    if (replace && KWorkSpace::isUsingSystemdBoot()) {
+        qCWarning(PLASMASHELL) << "The --replace option is intended for development and debugging. If you are not using it for that, in the future "
+                                  "please restart Plasma with \"systemctl restart --user plasma-plasmashell.service\" instead.";
+    }
+
     KDBusService service(KDBusService::Unique | KDBusService::StartupOption(replace ? KDBusService::Replace : 0));
 
     corona.init();
-- 
2.53.0

@@ -138,34 +140,11 @@ void Shutdown::logoutCancelled()

 }

-        return false;
-    } else {
-        msg = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1"),
-                                             reply.value().path(),
-                                             QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.DBus.Properties"),
-                                             QStringLiteral("Get"));
-        msg << QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1.Unit") << QStringLiteral("ActiveState");
-
-        QDBusReply<QVariant> reply = QDBusConnection::sessionBus().call(msg);
-        return reply.isValid() && reply.value().toString() == QLatin1String("active");
-    }
-}
-
 void Shutdown::logoutComplete()
 {
     runShutdownScripts();
 
-    if (usingSystemdManagedSession()) {
+    if (KWorkSpace::isUsingSystemdBoot()) {
         auto msg = QDBusMessage::createMethodCall(QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1"),
                                                   QStringLiteral("/org/freedesktop/systemd1"),
                                                   QStringLiteral("org.freedesktop.systemd1.Manager"),
diff --git a/startkde/plasma-shutdown/shutdown.h b/startkde/plasma-shutdown/shutdown.h
index 8bfe0ce1e6..afc5b6c20b 100644
--- a/startkde/plasma-shutdown/shutdown.h
+++ b/startkde/plasma-shutdown/shutdown.h
@@ -34,7 +34,6 @@ private Q_SLOTS:
 private:
     void startLogout(ShutdownType shutdownType);
     void runShutdownScripts();
-    bool usingSystemdManagedSession();
     // ShutdownTypeNone means idle, see startLogout().
     ShutdownType m_shutdownType = ShutdownTypeNone;
 };
--
